title: A network drop turned a real DOI into 'unresolvable'

found.context: Stage B live rerun; the network dropped mid-run

observed_failure: The DOI resolver confirmed the DOI, then every title-bearing index failed with URLError; the source got lookup_verified 'unresolvable' (NO_TITLE_TO_COMPARE), a negative-sounding verdict produced by an outage.
expected_behavior: If no title-bearing index answered, there is no verdict (LOOKUP_DEGRADED) and the lookup must be re-run. Degraded is not negative.

resolution.summary: NO_TITLE_TO_COMPARE requires an index that actually answered

lessons: Test the outage path live, not only the happy path: the bug was invisible until the network failed.
